rv.q: It works best as a showcase for the energetic young cast and what it does best – which is dance.
Melanie La Barrie also proves she can lead a cast as Old Deuteronomy who is ringleader for the only real plot you need to know.
The first half, however, needs greater energy, spectacle, individuality and visual clarity.

cn.t: This revival of Andrew Lloyd Webber's musical earns praise for its energetic young cast and strong dance performances, with the iconic song "Memory" and the composer's enduring score continuing to resonate powerfully.
